lines.zh: 丛林里我走得慢，身子太宽
lines.en: I walk slowly in the jungle, my body too wide
My big belly clears the way

lines.zh: 三根长爪垂着，几乎擦地
lines.en: Three long claws hang, almost scraping the ground

lines.zh: 我踩着落下的叶子，一点声音都没有
lines.en: I step on fallen leaves without a sound
Branches part against my back
I go through the gaps sideways

lines.zh: 丛林里的光，落在我脖子上
lines.en: The jungle light falls on my neck

lines.zh: 长脖子探到前面去，先看看
lines.en: My long neck reaches forward to look first
The legs are thick, each step takes a while

lines.zh: 热带丛林的湿气黏在毛上
lines.en: The wet heat of the jungle clings to my feathers

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边用爪子拨开藤
lines.en: I walk and push the vines aside with a claw
The shade is thick, and I go steadily
I push through the low bushes with my belly

lines.zh: 脚掌很大，踩下去就是一个坑
lines.en: My feet are broad, each step leaves a pit

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，得先挪后腿
lines.en: I turn slowly, the hind legs must move first

lines.zh: 丛林里的湿土黏在我的爪上
lines.en: The wet soil sticks to my claws
I stand with my claws hanging
The jungle insects never stop

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够高处的叶
lines.en: I stretch my neck for the higher leaves
Three claws, and they look frightening

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一堆藤
lines.en: When I am still, I look like a pile of vines
Leaves are being chewed slowly at my mouth
My belly is full and round

lines.zh: 阳光从树缝里一条条落下来
lines.en: Sunlight falls in strips through the canopy
My feathers are a little damp

lines.zh: 我听见有东西踩断了树枝
lines.en: I hear something snap a branch
I stand firm, the wind cannot push me

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，脖子绕了半圈
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, my neck half a circle
Nobody in the jungle sees me

lines.zh: 叶子上有水，我舔了两下
lines.en: There is water on the leaf, I lick it twice
You look quite small in front of me
I bring my long neck down

lines.zh: 我三根爪子，比你的手臂长
lines.en: My three claws are longer than your arms

lines.zh: 我不爱打架，可我站得住
lines.en: I am not fond of fighting, but I stand my ground

lines.zh: 你看我的肚子，会以为我慢
lines.en: Look at my belly and you would think me slow

lines.zh: 我脖子上的羽毛竖起来了
lines.en: The feathers on my neck have risen

lines.zh: 丛林里少见你这样的人
lines.en: People like you are rare in this jungle

lines.zh: 我低头，闻了闻你的味道
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff you
I eat leaves, not you
Step back and I lower my head again

lines.zh: 我鼻子里出了口气，退了退
lines.en: A breath left my nostrils and I eased back
A gash on my hide
My feathers stand up
That landed on my ribs
I dislike fighting, and I will answer

lines.zh: 我这三根长爪，是梳叶子的。
lines.en: These three long claws are for raking leaves.
Blood drips onto the leaves
The jungle is too wide, I cannot dodge
That was quicker than me
I steadied and did not fall
Is that a leaf in your hand
I stretch my neck to sniff
That piece is not one mouthful for me
I take it slowly and chew
The leaf is fresh, still wet

lines.zh: 你怀里的蕨叶，叶尖还在滴水。
lines.en: The fern fronds in your arms still drip at the tips.
I eat leaves and touch nothing else

lines.zh: 你手别伸进来，我牙是平的
lines.en: Keep your hand out, my teeth are flat
I have finished, and I raise my head

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我自己没动
lines.en: You hit my leg, I did not move

lines.zh: 我侧身让了半步，树都动了
lines.en: I shifted half a step and the trees moved

lines.zh: 我的肚子很软，你的骨头不是
lines.en: My belly is soft, your bones are not
Do not come from behind, I cannot see there

lines.zh: 这一下撞在你肩上，你退了
lines.en: That landed on your shoulder and you stepped back

lines.zh: 我的爪子碰到了你的袖子
lines.en: My claw grazed your sleeve
I backed to a tree and it broke
The path is narrow, walk slowly
Crowd me again and I have no room to give

lines.zh: 这一碰，我们俩都停住了
lines.en: At that touch we both stopped

lines.zh: 这一片丛林只有我一个
lines.en: I am the only one in this jungle

lines.zh: 我的爪子用来拨树枝，不干别的
lines.en: My claws push branches, nothing more

lines.zh: 肚子这么大，做事很不方便
lines.en: With a belly this size, many things are inconvenient

lines.zh: 我等了很久，也没有回应
lines.en: I have waited long with no answer
The trees are too dense for a call to carry
In this season I do not want to move
You are too close to my belly
Leaves matter more than such things
I walk off slowly to keep eating
Let us talk after the rain stops
I lower my head and nudge it with a claw

lines.zh: 三根爪子抓小的东西很难
lines.en: Three long claws are poor at small things
This is smaller than my nail
I pinch it between my claws
It dropped and I cannot find it
I take it up and set it on my tongue
It does not taste like a leaf
It rolled into the grass, I did not follow
I pushed it with the tip of my snout
Something is moving in the jungle
I straighten my neck to look
You think me slow, but my reach is long
I know every leaf in this stretch
I lift a claw

lines.zh: 你踩断了枯枝，我听见了
lines.en: You snapped a dead branch, I heard it
I take one step and the trees move
I do not start things, but I hold my ground

lines.zh: 这地方树太密，你跑不远
lines.en: The trees here are thick, you cannot get far

lines.zh: 我低头看着你，脖子绕了一圈
lines.en: I lower my head at you, my neck looping
The moment you turned, I moved
The sun happens to fall on you
I follow you through the vines

lines.zh: 你跑的方向有溪，会绕回来
lines.en: Your path has a stream, you will come back

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可我不会绕丢
lines.en: I move slowly, but I do not lose the trail

lines.zh: 你的脚印在湿土上很清楚
lines.en: Your prints show clearly in the wet soil
I raise my neck and see a long way

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮过树干，留下痕
lines.en: My claws leave marks on the trunks
I hear you panting ahead

lines.zh: 这里没有空地，你拦不住我
lines.en: There is no open ground, you cannot stop me
The leaves are too dense, you cannot see me
I go step by step, in no hurry

lines.zh: 我再往前，就到你后面了
lines.en: A little further and I am behind you

lines.zh: 风把树叶吹得直响，盖住脚步
lines.en: The wind rattles the leaves and covers footsteps

lines.zh: 我的影子在树影里，分不出来
lines.en: My shadow merges with the trees' shadows

lines.zh: 爪子横扫过去，藤全断了
lines.en: My claw sweeps through and the vines snap

lines.zh: 我用前肢撞你，慢慢压下来
lines.en: I push with a forelimb, bearing down slowly
You are swept against a tree

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓在你护甲上，划出三道
lines.en: My claws rake your armor, three lines
My foot comes down and the ground sinks
You retreat, and I do not hurry after

lines.zh: 这一撞，你手里的东西掉了
lines.en: That knocked the thing from your hand
My tail lashes you
You are wedged between two trees
When I lift a foot, you should move
A large shape has appeared in the jungle
I rise up out of the undergrowth
Three long claws come to the ground first
The vines part around me
The fallen leaves crunch under me

lines.zh: 这片丛林里，多了个吃叶子的
lines.en: The jungle has a new leaf eater
I stretch my neck to look around
The rain just stopped and I came out
My belly shows through the gap in the trees

lines.zh: 我慢慢走出来，没有声音
lines.en: I come out slowly and silently
A bird I startled takes flight

lines.zh: 这么宽的身子，只能侧着过
lines.en: A body this wide must go sideways
I shake the wet off myself

lines.zh: 我站在丛林深处，等天晴
lines.en: I stand deep in the jungle until it clears
Fire caught my feathers, the smell is sharp

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，肚子先着地
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and landed on my belly

lines.zh: 水没过我的脖子，我拼命伸头
lines.en: Water passed my neck, I stretched my head up

lines.zh: 炸得我脚下的土都翻了
lines.en: The blast turned the soil under me

lines.zh: 箭插在肩胛，我的长爪够不到。
lines.en: The arrow sits in my shoulder blade, beyond my long claws.
That force worked into my feathers

lines.zh: 叶子都被吃光了，我饿得站不住
lines.en: The leaves are gone and hunger makes me sway

lines.zh: 雷落在树顶，也落在我背上
lines.en: Lightning hit the treetops and my back

lines.zh: 这里没有树也没有叶子
lines.en: No trees here, and no leaves
